_docs.master_host_runtime: Agent CLI name the master session runs on (for example claude, codex, or grok).
_docs.transcript_globs: Map of runtime name to a filesystem glob that locates that runtime's session JSONL transcripts for model-identity probes.
_docs.product_repositories: Non-empty array of absolute paths of the product repositories this master serves; the canonical key. The one-entry string form product_repo is still accepted; when both are present, product_repositories wins. Omit both when the workspace has no product repository.
_docs.unavailable_runtimes: Optional map of runtime name to {since, why, until}, all non-empty strings, until a YYYY-MM-DD date; operator-declared runtimes this machine or account cannot dispatch to, expiring after until. Absent key means no change.
_docs.codex_reasoning_effort: Optional reasoning effort for codex workers launched by dispatch: one of minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, or max. Absent or null keeps xhigh; any other value is refused.
_docs.codex_bypass_approvals_and_sandbox: Optional boolean, default false. true adds --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox to the codex worker launch, which disables codex's sandbox as well as its approvals; an explicit operator opt-in for workers that already run inside an external sandbox.
